Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.controller.GameController
All Implemented Interfaces:
InputEventListener
public class GameController extends Object implements InputEventListener
Main game controller that coordinates game logic, user input, and view updates. Implements the InputEventListener interface to handle player input events. Responsibilities: - Managing game state and flow - Handling player input (keyboard and mouse) - Coordinating between Board model and GuiController view - Managing power-ups (Freeze, Bomb, Drill) - Handling game modes (Classic, Mirror, Power-Ups) - Managing bedrock corruption in Power-Ups mode - Score management and leaderboard integration
